description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a test framework for Git. It includes environment setup, prerequisite checks, test execution control, and utilities for handling test output, leaks, and parallel stress testing. It is used to facilitate automated testing of Git components and features.

methods.name: prepend_var
methods.description: Utility function to prepend a value to an environment variable with a delimiter.

methods.name: make_symlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link if it doesn't exist or is out of date, used for setting up valgrind test environment.

methods.name: make_valgrind_symlink
methods.description: Creates symlinks for git executables in the valgrind directory for memory leak testing.

methods.name: remove_trash_directory
methods.description: Removes the specified directory, adjusting permissions if necessary, used to prepare test environment.
